options.content:
# COPY · Swing (multi-day follow-in → net-flow follow-out)
Thesis: follow a wallet IN, exit only when it net-distributes ≥50% of its build (holds through suppression sells). Edge is tail-dependent — watch **hold time** (design = multi-day) and **net PnL by wallet** (demote losers).

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM halts WHERE bot_id='copy_swing' AND resumed_at IS NULL) THEN 'halted' ELSE 'paper' END AS state
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wallet_pool WHERE swing = true AND tier = 'active'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='open' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='swing'
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(pnl_usd)::numeric, 2), 0) FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='swing'

SELECT ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pnl_usd > 0)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) * 100)::numeric, 1) FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='swing'

SELECT ROUND(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (exit_at-entry_at))/3600.0)::numeric, 2) FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='swing' AND exit_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT exit_at AS time, SUM(pnl_usd) OVER (ORDER BY exit_at) AS pnl_cum FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND exit_at IS NOT NULL AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='swing' ORDER BY exit_at
SELECT exit_at AS time, pnl_pct AS value FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND exit_at IS NOT NULL AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='swing' ORDER BY exit_at

panels.title: Net PnL by trigger wallet (roster performance — demote losers)

targets.rawSql: SELECT LEFT(sim_metadata->>'trigger_wallet', 6) AS wallet, ROUND(SUM(pnl_usd)::numeric, 2) AS net_pnl, COUNT(*) AS n FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='swing' AND sim_metadata->>'trigger_wallet' IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY net_pnl DESC

panels.title: Exit-reason × hold-time (design = multi-day; follow-out should NOT fire in minutes)

targets.rawSql: SELECT exit_reason, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(SUM(pnl_usd)::numeric,2) AS net_pnl, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (exit_at-entry_at))/3600.0)::numeric,2) AS avg_hold_h, ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pnl_usd>0)::float/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)*100)::numeric,0) AS win_pct FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='swing' AND exit_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY exit_reason ORDER BY n DESC

panels.title: Open paper trades (age_h = how long we've held)

targets.rawSql: SELECT id, asset, venue AS chain, LEFT(sim_metadata->>'trigger_wallet', 8) AS trigger, ROUND((sim_metadata->>'conviction_accumulated_usd')::numeric, 0) AS net_accum_usd, sim_metadata->>'conviction_n_buys' AS n_buys, size_usd, ROUND((sim_metadata->>'peak_pct_since_entry')::numeric, 1) AS peak_pct, ROUND((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now()-entry_at))/3600.0)::numeric,1) AS age_h, entry_at FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='open' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='swing' ORDER BY entry_at DESC

panels.title: Closed paper trades (last 50 — hold_h surfaces early follow-outs)

targets.rawSql: SELECT id, asset, LEFT(sim_metadata->>'trigger_wallet', 8) AS trigger, ROUND((sim_metadata->>'conviction_accumulated_usd')::numeric, 0) AS net_accum_usd, size_usd, ROUND((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (exit_at-entry_at))/3600.0)::numeric,2) AS hold_h, ROUND(pnl_pct::numeric, 2) AS pnl_pct, ROUND(pnl_usd::numeric, 2) AS pnl_usd, exit_reason, entry_at, exit_at FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND sim_metadata->>'strategy'='swing' ORDER BY exit_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50
SELECT halted_at, halt_type, severity, LEFT(reason, 100) AS reason, resumed_at, resumed_by FROM halts WHERE bot_id='copy_swing' AND halted_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days' ORDER BY halted_at DESC
